Question ID: JOUR_U04_L02_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.JOUR.MED.02

Source: Headline: Advisory Campaign Encourages Students to Arrive on Time. Body: The article explains that the school is starting a two-week advisory campaign about arriving on time. The central idea is that consistent arrival helps students begin class prepared. The article supports this idea with three details: the assistant principal says students miss opening instructions when they arrive late, a teacher says the first five minutes often include warm-up practice, and a student mentor says reminders in advisory can help students plan morning routines.
